# EzSplitBill

> EzSplitBill is a free split bill web app at https://ezsplitbill.vercel.app. Enter a receipt once, share a link, and let each person calculate their share. Guests can open shared bills without signing in.

Signed-in users can save bills, scan receipt photos into line items, and manage bills from a dashboard. The app supports tax, service charges, discounts, and multi-currency totals.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://ezsplitbill.vercel.app/): Overview and shortcuts to create or open bills.
- [How it works](https://ezsplitbill.vercel.app/how-it-works): Step by step guide for creating and sharing bills.
- [Privacy](https://ezsplitbill.vercel.app/privacy): How EzSplitBill handles accounts, receipt scans, saved bills, and cookies.
- [Login](https://ezsplitbill.vercel.app/login): Sign in to save and manage bills.
- [Register](https://ezsplitbill.vercel.app/register): Create a free account.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://ezsplitbill.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Public URL list for crawlers.
